rows.label: Dual Ichor research
rows.note: prerequisite for Djinn; 5,000 cr, 60 Mutagen Sample, 800 Circuits, 9,500 Nano Spores, 1,200 Polymer Bundle

conditions: Costs multiply with clan tier: x3 Shadow, x10 Storm, x30 Mountain, x100 Moon; stay Ghost tier if researching alone.

groups.meta: a separate unlock from Dual Ichor

skip.reason: Bio Lab already has Mutagen Mass researched

rows.label: Mutagen Mass research
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 5 Mutagen Sample, 150 Circuits, 500 Nano Spores, 100 Plastids

conditions: Both this and Dual Ichor have to be done; neither substitutes for the other.

rows.label: Mutagen Sample
rows.note: uncommon drop; covers Dual Ichor research, Mutagen Mass research and six Mass crafts

conditions: Samples are only uncommon on Deimos and rare on Eris; farm Deimos, not Eris.
Infested often clump in Terrorem's side rooms; hold a tile with good pathing or run Defense instead.
bonuses: A loot frame (Nekros Despoil, Khora Pilfering Strangledome, Atlas Ore Gaze) plus a Resourceful Retriever beast, a relay Resource Drop Chance Blessing, a Resource Booster and Steel Path all stack.

rows.label: Mutagen Mass
rows.note: 10 Mutagen Sample, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage, 250 Plastids each

conditions: Each Mutagen Mass blueprint is single-use; six separate 15,000-credit purchases are needed for six Mass.
bonuses: Solaris United bounties (level 30-50, Rotation C) sometimes reward a crafted Mutagen Mass outright, skipping the blueprint, credits and Control Module for that one.

rows.label: Forma
rows.alt: or 20 p each in the Market

conditions: Free both companion slots before claiming; Djinn and its Stinger weapon each take one.

disclosures.title: master and sell
disclosures.body: Djinn is widely called weak; most players rank it to 30 for Mastery (about 9,000 combined with Stinger) and then sell it.
